comment: No family is set on any of the four jacks: the module compares whatever voltages are patched, and the maker's manual calls them CV or audio. The manual has the two outputs the wrong way round — it says MIN carries 'whichever is greater' and MAX 'whichever is less', while MNMXCore.cc:37-38 puts the minimum on MIN and the maximum on MAX.
